newsitem.title: USA: Dow Industrials weak at opening.
newsitem.headline: Dow Industrials weak at opening.

text.p: U.S. blue-chip share prices were weak at the opening on Thursday, depressed by a soft bond market.
But technology issues were strong and analysts said a turnaround was possible.
The Dow Jones industrial average was down four at 6,032 but the NASDAQ Index was up three at 1,231. The S&P Index was down fractionally at 707.
The long bond was down 8/32 to yield 6.85 percent.
